column1: # Lexime curated extras: IT / business vocabulary not covered by Mozc UT.
# Format: reading[TAB]surface[TAB]pos[TAB]cost (exactly 4 columns)
#   - reading: hiragana
#   - pos: a full 7-field id.def POS tag, one of this domain's set
#     (`DOMAINS` in extras.rs). compile resolves the tag to its numeric id from the pinned
#     id.def; a tag outside the set, a tag missing from id.def, or a missing
#     id.def fails the build.
#   - cost: required, a non-negative i16. Lower = higher rank. It is the
#     entry's final cost: compile's POS-based cost offsets (person name etc.)
#     belong to the Mozc import and are not applied to extras rows.
# Comment lines start with '#'. Blank lines are ignored.
# POS rule: an extras row takes the majority POS that Mozc (the pinned
# mozc-raw) gives to words of the same kind — proper noun or common noun, and
# the subdivision. Only when Mozc has no word of that kind, or the count is
# split, is the POS decided by the word's meaning. Each section (a block of
# rows of one kind) carries a comment with the kind, the representative words
# and the counts. The full rule is the doc of ALLOWED_POS_TAGS in extras.rs.
# (units.tsv is the exception: its rows are counters, 名詞,接尾,助数詞, priced
# by its own header rule; the canonical statement is that same doc.)
# Cost rule: a proper-noun row's cost is the median, over the same
# representative words, of each word's cheapest Mozc entry in the decided POS
# (floored, Mozc's raw value), stated in the section comment; the full rule is
# in the same ALLOWED_POS_TAGS doc.
# 種類 = 概念・物の名 (CS / 業務 / 開発用語)。判定: 普通名詞 16/16 が過半
# かつ単独最多 → 名詞,一般 (他の区分 固有名詞,一般 1/16)。
# 代表語 16 / Mozc に在る 16 / 票を持つ 16。除いた別語のエントリ 1 件
# (デプロイ の 組織)。
# 代表語: 可換 冗長 再帰 排他 同期 非同期 朝礼 定例 稟議 仕掛品 ネスト
# コミット マージ デプロイ サーバー コンピュータ
# 以下この file の全行。
べきとう
# --- 業務 / スクラム ---
あさかい
しかかり
# --- 開発用語 (#261/#263 history-audit) ---
